transcript.statement: The requirements of SafetyAgent are essential for ensuring the library management system operates reliably and safely. SAF-01 prevents over-borrowing, reducing risks of lost items. SAF-02 ensures timely notifications for overdue books, promoting member accountability. SAF-03 maintains real-time inventory, preventing double borrowing. SAF-04 ensures data recovery in failures, crucial for reliability. SAF-05 allows for the revocation of borrowing privileges for members with overdue books, enhancing safety. SAF-06 secures access for registered members, and SAF-07 logs transactions for auditing, ensuring accountability.

transcript.statement: The requirements from TrustworthinessAgent are essential for ensuring the security and privacy of library members' data. TRU-02 mandates logging of all borrowing transactions, which is critical for auditability. TRU-03 enforces data encryption for personal information, safeguarding against data breaches. TRU-04 implements role-based access control, enhancing security for both librarians and members. TRU-05 provides secure mechanisms for managing overdue books, while TRU-06 allows members to update their information securely. Lastly, TRU-07 enforces strong password policies, vital for protecting accounts.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours.
The system shall maintain real-time updates of book availability to ensure accurate information.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall allow a dynamic borrowing system that adjusts based on a member's borrowing quota.
The system shall ensure accessibility for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall implement energy-efficient technologies that minimize energy consumption.
The system shall track energy savings achieved through efficient operations.
The system shall encrypt all member personal information stored to protect data.
